blocks.text: The true cost of poor safety stock management

When you fail at optimizing safety stock, your company pays in two ways. First, you hold too much inventory, which ties up working capital that could be used elsewhere. Second, you hold too little, leading to stockouts that damage customer trust and revenue.

Increasing service levels from 95 percent to 99 percent can nearly double your required safety stock. This math is unforgiving. Every extra unit sitting in a warehouse is a cost against your bottom line. If your planning process is manual, you are likely overcompensating for uncertainty by keeping extra stock just in case.
Why safety stock adjustments become a full time job

Safety stock is not a number you set once. It is a living metric. Demand fluctuations, supplier delays, and seasonal trends mean that yesterday's safety stock is often wrong for today. Without automated alerts, you are stuck in a cycle of manual spreadsheet updates.

items: Supplier lead time variability: When your vendors are late, your buffer shrinks.
Demand volatility: Social media trends or weather events can spike demand overnight.
Forecast inaccuracy: Your statistical models are only as good as the data they receive.
Strategic shifts: Changes in company policy regarding service level targets require recalculations.

blocks.text: Fixes for optimizing safety stock without new software

You do not always need expensive enterprise software to improve. Start by organizing your data. Use ABC-XYZ classification to segment your items. Focus your energy on items with high value and high demand variability. These items cause the most financial pain when mismanaged.

items: Audit your lead time data: Ensure the lead times in your ERP reflect reality, not just the contract terms.
Clean your historical data: Remove outliers from past demand if they were caused by one-time events like a pandemic or a massive promotion.
Implement a hybrid model: Combine basic replenishment rules with advanced classification to prioritize your manual review time.
Review service levels: Challenge the assumption that every SKU needs a 99 percent service level.

blocks.text: Using your Mac to manage inventory data

Most supply chain planners work in web browsers like Chrome or Safari. Your Mac is a powerful tool for this. Use Split View by hovering over the green button in the top left of any window to compare your ERP dashboard with your Excel analysis. This makes it easier to spot discrepancies between your forecast and your actual stock levels.

faq.question: Does Lazur change my inventory levels automatically?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or change data in your ERP. It points at the screen and answers your questions so you can make faster, better decisions yourself.

faq.question: Is safety stock optimization different for small businesses?
faq.answer: The principles remain the same, but the tools change. Smaller companies often use tools like QuickBooks or Zoho Inventory on their Mac, while larger firms rely on NetSuite or SAP.
